description: Tell us which sectors and goals matter most to your city, how quickly actions must be implementable, and whether any types of actions should be excluded from the ranking.
alignment-note: Alignment shapes 22% of the ranking — priority sectors 15% · timeframe preference 5% · strategic priorities 5%
priority-sectors-description: Select the sectors your city wants to prioritize. Actions in these sectors will receive a higher alignment score.
strategic-priorities-description: Select the co-benefits your city wants to emphasize. Actions that deliver these co-benefits alongside emissions reductions will score higher in the alignment ranking.
timeline-description: Select your city's preferred implementation horizon. Actions whose timeline matches your preference receive a higher alignment score.
timeline-short-sub: Actions implementable in less than 5 years
exclusions-description: Specify which types of actions your city wants to exclude from the ranking. In the pre-flight summary, you will be able to review and confirm which specific actions are proposed for exclusion before running the ranking.
exclude-by-sector-description: All actions belonging to these sectors will be proposed for exclusion.
exclude-by-co-benefit-description: Actions that have a negative effect on the selected co-benefits will be proposed for exclusion.
co-benefits-marked-for-exclusion_one: {{count}} co-benefit selected — actions with negative impact on it will be proposed for exclusion
co-benefits-marked-for-exclusion_other: {{count}} co-benefits selected — actions with negative impact on these will be proposed for exclusion
exclude-free-text-description: Describe any other actions to exclude — for example, actions already under way, politically infeasible, or outside your mandate.
exclude-free-text-placeholder: Do not include actions related to electric vehicles or electric mobility
no-exclusions-set: No exclusion criteria set — all actions will be included in the ranking.
